summary: Build SBTi-aligned targets, Scope 3 plans, and a credible net-zero roadmap in five practical days. Enrol now.
lede: Science-based target setting helps sustainability and ESG professionals translate emissions data into climate-aligned reduction goals and net-zero plans. Learners practice building Scope 1, 2 and 3 baselines, structuring near- and long-term targets, and selecting decarbonization levers. They also develop supplier-engagement plans, emissions-reduction roadmaps and progress-reporting materials to support governance and validation readiness.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with climate data, ESG disclosures, or decarbonization planning and need to shape credible science-based targets and net-zero strategy outputs.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of greenhouse gas emissions concepts, corporate sustainability reporting, and basic Excel-based data handling. Familiarity with the GHG Protocol, Scope 1-2-3 accounting, and SBTi terminology will help you move faster, although the course will revisit the essentials before advancing into target design and validation logic. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing emissions datasets, target tables, and management reporting packs.
